stk-push.title: STK Push
stk-push.code:
from daraja import Mpesa, MpesaConfig, STKPushRequest

mpesa = Mpesa(MpesaConfig(
    consumer_key=os.environ["MPESA_CONSUMER_KEY"],
    consumer_secret=os.environ["MPESA_CONSUMER_SECRET"],
    environment="sandbox",
    passkey=os.environ["MPESA_PASSKEY"],
))

resp = mpesa.stk_push(STKPushRequest(
    BusinessShortCode=174379,
    TransactionType="CustomerPayBillOnline",
    Amount=1,
    PartyA=254722000000,
    PartyB=174379,
    PhoneNumber=254722111111,
    CallBackURL="https://example.com/callback",
    AccountReference="INV-001",
    TransactionDesc="Payment",
))

print(resp.CheckoutRequestID)

from daraja import Mpesa, MpesaConfig, C2BSimulateRequest

mpesa = Mpesa(MpesaConfig(
    consumer_key=os.environ["MPESA_CONSUMER_KEY"],
    consumer_secret=os.environ["MPESA_CONSUMER_SECRET"],
    environment="sandbox",
))

resp = mpesa.c2b_simulate(C2BSimulateRequest(
    ShortCode=174379,
    CommandID="CustomerPayBillOnline",
    Amount=1,
    Msisdn=254722000000,
    BillRefNumber="INV-001",
))

print(resp.ResponseCode, resp.ResponseDescription)
